claim_boundary: This one-acetone gas-phase source falsifier compares only the zero-field GFN2-xTB MOLDEN valence-density plus parameter-derived effective-core electrostatic potential with the frozen omegaB97M-V/def2-TZVPD all-electron static MEP at every one of 516 immutable exterior points. It invokes no response, continuum, PCM, cavity, solvation energy, force, experimental solvation label, post-training, fine tuning, source fit, point selection, or new QM SCF calculation. V2 retains the checkpoint file hash as the QM identity and requires frozen energy/dipole compatibility with the independent finite-field record; it does not reuse that record's non-comparable byte-level density digest. A pass cannot establish a speed advantage or chemical accuracy.
decision_rule: If any source-transfer, QM-binding, or registered static-MEP gate fails, reject this exact GFN2 MOLDEN permanent-source candidate. Do not change effective cores, Gaussian coefficients, MOLDEN convention, points, threshold, response, continuum, or use a solvation label. A pass admits only the same source to separately preregistered all-electron cavity completion and common-scalar/KKT gates. This V2 protocol is valid only because V1 stopped before a scientific static-MEP decision and its preflight evidence is preserved below.

protocol_revision.reason: V1 stopped before a source verdict because it equated a density SHA emitted by an independent finite-field SCF with the density reconstructed from the frozen checkpoint. V2 retains all candidate, point, runtime, checkpoint-file, and scientific-threshold identities, but replaces only that invalid cross-execution byte-equality preflight with checkpoint-energy and permanent-dipole compatibility.

source_definition.candidate: zero-field GFN2-xTB closed-shell MOLDEN valence AO density plus effective cores derived from the version-bound GFN2 ao= declarations
source_definition.candidate_points: all 516 frozen exterior points; no subset, cavity, or continuum is constructed
source_definition.candidate_response: forbidden; the previously rejected xTB field response is not loaded or compared
source_definition.integral_transfer: printed MOLDEN coefficients are divided by the known PySCF primitive radial normalization and then required to reproduce the raw MOLDEN AO overlap and dipole
source_definition.qm_comparator: frozen all-electron gas-phase omegaB97M-V/def2-TZVPD RKS checkpoint; its preregistered file hash is the comparator identity and its energy/dipole must agree with the independent frozen finite-field record

threshold_provenance: The 0.20 global relative-MEP/dipole and 0.30 maximum-relative-MEP falsification scales are unchanged from V1 and were frozen before any static-MEP norm was formed or read. The 1e-8 to 1e-6 representation thresholds remain algebraic transfer/geometry gates. V2 adds a 1e-9 Hartree checkpoint-energy and 1e-8 e bohr permanent-dipole compatibility preflight because V1's cross-execution raw-density byte hash could not identify the already hash-pinned checkpoint.
